description: CAT-V, parameter state. A saved parameter select QP (pV Long) and a saved parameter update QU (pV, pId) are reached through four instances: two Item() calls on one Database, one on a second Database of the same Workspace, one on a Database of a second Workspace. pV is set on one instance and read on all four, then set on another; each instance opens a recordset after its own value was set; a dynaset opened from qd1 gets pV changed on qd1 and Recordset.Requery() with no argument; QU is executed repeatedly with changing pV and pId (Errors before/after, RecordsAffected), then qd1.SQL is set to its own text and pV is read. Asks whether parameter state is shared or private per instance, per Database and per Workspace, and when Requery() sees a new value.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
